documentation.usageCode:
import {
  ImageCropperRoot,
  ImageCropperViewport,
  ImageCropperImage,
  ImageCropperCropArea,
  ImageCropperHandle,
  ImageCropperZoomControl,
  ImageCropperStatus,
} from '@uifn/components-react/image-cropper'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ImageCropperRoot src="/components/crop-landscape.svg" defaultCrop={{"x":120,"y":75,"width":400,"height":250}} aspectRatio={1.6} minSize={80} maxSize={520} defaultZoom={1}>
      <ImageCropperViewport>
        <ImageCropperImage />
        <ImageCropperCropArea>
          <ImageCropperHandle value="nw" />
          <ImageCropperHandle value="ne" />
          <ImageCropperHandle value="sw" />
          <ImageCropperHandle value="se" />
        </ImageCropperCropArea>
        <ImageCropperZoomControl />
        <ImageCropperStatus>Ready to crop</ImageCropperStatus>
      </ImageCropperViewport>
    </ImageCropperRoot>
  )
}

import {
  SliderRoot,

  SliderThumb,

      <SliderHiddenInput value={0} />

documentation.usageCode:
import {
  ColorPickerRoot,
  ColorPickerLabel,
  ColorPickerControl,
  ColorPickerTrigger,
  ColorPickerPositioner,
  ColorPickerContent,
  ColorPickerArea,
  ColorPickerAreaThumb,
  ColorPickerChannelSlider,
  ColorPickerChannelInput,
  ColorPickerSwatch,
  ColorPickerHiddenInput,
} from '@uifn/components-react/color-picker'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ColorPickerRoot name="brand-color" defaultValue="#635bff" alpha messages={{"channels":{"r":"Red","g":"Green","b":"Blue","alpha":"Alpha"}}}>
      <ColorPickerLabel>Brand color</ColorPickerLabel>
      <ColorPickerControl>
        <ColorPickerTrigger type="button">Choose color</ColorPickerTrigger>
        <ColorPickerSwatch />
      </ColorPickerControl>
      <ColorPickerPositioner>
        <ColorPickerContent>
          <ColorPickerArea>
            <ColorPickerAreaThumb />
          </ColorPickerArea>
          <ColorPickerChannelSlider value="r" />
          <ColorPickerChannelInput value="r" />
        </ColorPickerContent>
      </ColorPickerPositioner>
      <ColorPickerHiddenInput />
    </ColorPickerRoot>
  )
}

documentation.usageCode:
import {
  CarouselRoot,
  CarouselViewport,
  CarouselItem,
  CarouselPrevious,
  CarouselNext,
  CarouselIndicatorGroup,
  CarouselIndicator,
  CarouselLiveRegion,
} from '@uifn/components-react/carousel'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <CarouselRoot itemCount={3} defaultIndex={0} aria-label="Carousel example">
      <CarouselViewport>
        <CarouselItem value={0}>Project overview</CarouselItem>
        <CarouselItem value={1}>Recent activity</CarouselItem>
        <CarouselItem value={2}>Deployment status</CarouselItem>
      </CarouselViewport>
      <CarouselPrevious type="button">Previous slide</CarouselPrevious>
      <CarouselNext type="button">Next slide</CarouselNext>
      <CarouselIndicatorGroup>
        <CarouselIndicator type="button" value={0} />
        <CarouselIndicator type="button" value={1} />
        <CarouselIndicator type="button" value={2} />
      </CarouselIndicatorGroup>
      <CarouselLiveRegion>Slide 1 of 3</CarouselLiveRegion>
    </CarouselRoot>
  )
}
